title: Autonomy gate evidence artifact
description: Per ADR-037 D3. Emitted by a local-only gate (live golden, Docker integration, adversarial audit) that GitHub CI cannot run. Committed to the PR branch under evidence/<gate>.json. The ci-evidence job asserts freshness (head_sha == PR head) + verdict == PASS for every gate the phase declares in evidence/manifest.json. Makes local gates un-fakeable at merge and doubles as founder's post-hoc audit trail.

schema_version.description: Bump when the shape changes; verify_evidence.py pins this.

gate.description: Stable gate id, matches an entry in evidence/manifest.json required_gates (e.g. live_golden_memory, docker_integration, adversarial_audit).

head_sha.description: Full 40-char SHA of the commit the gate actually ran against. MUST equal the PR head SHA at CI time, else the evidence is stale and the gate fails.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the gate completed.

verdict.description: PASS is the only value that lets ci-evidence go green for this gate.

cost_usd.description: LLM/infra spend to produce this evidence (funded live goldens). Feeds the per-run budget audit.

runner.description: Who produced it — agent role / script name (e.g. scripts/live_golden_memory.py, reviewer-security).

details.description: Free-form gate-specific payload: golden pass counts, reviewer verdicts + refute-by-default confirmation, integration suite summary, etc.
